summary: Frontend-only verification of Waterdrop Survivor's Phase C/D/E boot confirmation + 5 new session items (vignette fix, dynamic point lights, gore Phase A wounds, blood pooling growth, level-up water-to-ash text) plus full regression smoke test. Ran ~12 full playthroughs (create character -> intro dialogue -> Welcome home -> ENTER THE LAKE -> intro dialogue -> gameplay canvas) across multiple browser automation sessions with zero console/page errors observed at any point (webpack also compiles clean with only pre-existing unused-var lint warnings, no errors). Confirmed via window.__game state inspection + screenshots: (1) Vignette code review shows the 4-corner-circle overlay fully replaced with a single centered PIXI FillGradient radial gradient in _ensureVignette/_drawScreenOverlays -- screenshots at game start/mid-combat show a clean symmetric dark ring with no blotchy patches at mid-left/mid-right (old bug pattern absent); (2) Dynamic lights: _drawLights additive gLight layer visibly brightens the ground/starfield in a soft warm circle around the player in every gameplay screenshot -- confirmed real additive glow, not a flat sticker; boss aura code reviewed but not empirically observed (no boss encountered in short test runs -- code path is straightforward color/alpha circle keyed to game.bossActive, low risk); (3) Gore Phase A: engine.dealDamage's 10%-threshold wound logic verified via window.__game state -- after ~10 hits on an enemy without killing it, e._wounds.length was >=1 with correct hp/maxHp ratios, and _drawEnemies renders dark red/black wound-patch circles at recorded local offsets; (4) Blood pooling growth: bloodDecals entries carry bornAt timestamps and _drawDecals grows radius over 0.4s with a darker clotted core past 50% grown -- confirmed via code review and decal count reaching the pre-existing 150-decal cap during sustained combat testing; (5) Level-up water-to-ash text: calling the real engine.addXp() (not state injection) correctly triggered the LevelUpModal card-selection overlay (game logic pauses live text timer while modal is open, by design), and after picking a card via data-testid=card-0, a screenshot captured the canvas-rendered 'LEVEL UP!' floating text with the existing teal AoE flash overlay and window.__game state confirmed 32 'ash'-type particles spawned in game.parts -- feature is present and firing correctly.
action_items: Low priority: bloodDecals array (engine.js, cap=150, lines ~1428-1832) has no eviction/expiry of old entries -- once 150 decals accumulate in a long/busy run, no NEW decals (including new wound-stage pools and enemy-death pooling splats) will render at all for the rest of the run since the array never shrinks. This is pre-existing behavior (not introduced this session) but now more noticeable since Gore Phase A adds more decal-spawning triggers (every 10% HP threshold hit) -- consider a small LRU/oldest-first eviction so late-run gore effects don't silently stop appearing.

Not empirically verified this pass (low risk, code reviewed only): boss point-light aura in _drawLights (requires spawning/surviving to a boss wave, which short automated test runs didn't reach) -- recommend a longer natural playthrough or a debug/cheat trigger to confirm visually if time allows.
critical_code_review_comments: pixiRenderer.js _ensureVignette/_drawScreenOverlays: correct single FillGradient radial approach, cached per-resize (W/H) with proper destroy() on old gradient -- no stale gradient leaks.
pixiRenderer.js _drawLights: clean additive-blend implementation (gLight.blendMode='add') inserted between gGround and gDecals so ground/decals genuinely brighten -- matches spec intent exactly.

engine.js dealDamage(): wound-stage math (Math.floor((1-hpPct)*10), capped at 9) correctly fires spawnWoundBurst only on NEW thresholds via e._woundStage tracking; spawnEnemy/spawnBoss reset _woundStage/_wounds on pool reuse -- verified via grep, no stale wounds observed across enemy pool recycling in testing.

engine.js _maybeLevelUp(): the DOM-level LevelUpModal (card selection) and the canvas-level water-to-ash floating text are two separate, independently-timed systems -- the canvas text timer (_levelUpTextTimer) only ticks down once gameplay resumes after a card is chosen, since the update loop appears gated while the modal is open. This is correct/expected UX (you don't want the floating text animation to play out invisibly behind a paused modal), not a bug.
Minor: bloodDecals cap of 150 with no removal (see action_items) is the one structural gap worth flagging to main agent, though out of this session's stated scope.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Flow gotcha for automation: the AIDA IntroDialogue component (data-testid='intro-dialogue') appears TWICE per full run -- once right after character creation (4 lines) and again right after clicking data-testid='welcome-fight' (ENTER THE LAKE) before the gameplay canvas mounts (another 4 lines). Each line needs its own click to fully-type-then-advance (typewriter effect via setInterval~22ms/char); clicking too fast before text finishes just completes the current line instead of advancing, so budget ~2 clicks/line worst-case (~8-16 clicks total) with ~700-900ms between clicks, or just loop-click on '[data-testid="intro-dialogue"]' until locator count()==0. window.__game exposes live engine state (game.enemies/game.parts/game.bloodDecals are Pool-like with .forEach + .alive checks); calling window.__game.addXp(1000) is a legitimate way to trigger a real level-up via actual game logic (not a fake state injection) for faster testing of level-up-dependent visuals. LevelUpModal card buttons use data-testid='card-0'/'card-1'/'card-2'.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A -- no new bugs found this pass. All 5 requested new/fixed features (vignette radial gradient, additive dynamic lights, progressive wound patches, growing blood pools, water-to-ash level-up text) were verified present and functioning via a mix of live gameplay screenshots and window.__game state inspection, with zero console errors across ~12 full playthrough sessions.
